brands.description:
Plastic can take hundreds of years to degrade. Often, they get smaller and smaller until they become microplastics, which are now everywhere. It is very harmful to marine life, contaminates our food, and pollutes our oceans.

There are currently an estimated 75-199 million tons of plastics in our oceans. That’s why we partnered with trusted and certified organizations like Plastic Fischer, Plastic Bank, Oceans Integrity, See Turtles, and others to help clean the ocean and prevent more plastic from reaching open waters.

Our partners work with local river and coastal communities, giving them incentives or hiring them to help collect plastic or build swimming barriers. Plastic is then sorted and recycled. Our partners' efforts cover inland collection to prevent plastics from reaching ocean-bound rivers, coastal beaches, and river cleanups, as well as ocean clean up efforts.

brands.description:
Trees produce the air we breathe, filter the water we drink, provide habitats for the pollinators responsible for providing us with food, and mitigate the effect of heat waves by providing shade to a wide variety of landscapes. They take in CO2 from the air and use it to grow while converting it into breathable air (a.k.a. oxygen). Forests have absorbed a net average of 7.6 billion tons of CO2 yearly between 2001 and 2019 alone!

Our partners plant trees where needed the most. They work in more than 40 countries and focus on the most important ecosystems. These areas are critical for fighting climate change and lowering carbon levels. This is hard work. They need to clear the land, nurse the saplings, transplant them from the nursery to the planting grounds, and monitor them as they grow to evaluate survival. We partner with trusted and certified organizations like Arbor Day Foundation, Eden Reforestation Projects, and One Tree Planted.

brands.description:
Protecting wildlife habitats means setting apart and protecting entire chunks of an ecosystem, instead of focusing on one species. This is required so that the selected ecosystems can maintain their function and role in regulating climate and biodiversity. Our partners work in key areas around the world that are home to thousands of unique and irreplaceable species. These areas perform crucial roles in global climate regulation, like the Amazon Forest, the Atlantic Forest, Tundras, and more.

We partner with trusted organizations like Rainforest Trust, WeForest, Asociaciòn ProPurùs, Fundación Jocotoco, Snow Leopard Trust and David Shepherd Wildlife Foundation. Our partners are spread across a chain of stages to protect wildlife habitats: designating land a protected area, supporting infrastructure installation to ensure protection, restoring degraded landscapes, and managing reserves and protected area activities. Our partners work with local communities, authorities, and the scientific community to maintain and ensure the protection status, offering training and operational support to local communities in not only restoring or maintaining a protected area, but also developing sustainable ways to support livelihoods around those activities.

brands.description:
Hello Alvin is like having an online doctor at your fingertips, 24/7 from any device, nationwide.  Give someone you care about the gift of 24-hour access to medical care from any phone, tablet or computer.  Simply request a live voice or video consult with an online physician or pediatrician using Teladoc, the world’s largest telehealth network. Hello Alvin saves you and your family time, money and hassle when a minor illness occurs.

Using Hello Alvin requires no insurance and anyone can sign up. Employers, employees, individuals and families can all benefit from the time and costs savings of getting convenient, low-cost medical care for themselves or their loved ones when a routine illness occurs, like a cough, cold, flu, upper respiratory infection, sinus infection or dozens of other conditions.

Each gift subscription allows anyone in the family to have a live voice or video consult with one of our more than 3,000 U.S. Board Certified Teladoc physicians or pediatricians online from anywhere they want, anytime they want and as often as they want. Each consult is just $45 and you can get a prescription or refill, if needed.

Every subscription will also have access to our free and unlimited 24-hour Registered Nurse Advice Line and 24-hour Email-a-Doctor service, which can be used as often as needed with no additional charge. 

Call a nurse and ask a question or Email a variety of healthcare providers, like a doctor, pediatrician, dentist, pharmacist, dietician, fitness pro and more. Get a quick response to your medical question without leaving your home or office.

Of course, if this is a medical emergency, please seek immediate assistance from 911 or visit an Emergency Room.
brands.shortDescription: With the gift of Hello Alvin, employees, individuals and families can have 24-hour access to doctors online from their phone, tablet or computer.  No more time off of work or school, and no more late night or expensive trips to urgent care or emergency room for a minor illness. More than 3,000 Board Certified Teladoc telehealth physicians and pediatricians are available nationwide, 24 hours a day, in less than 10 minutes.  Speak or video-chat with a physician, get a prescription and be on your way for just $45 per visit.  Hello Alvin makes an amazing gift or reward for employees and it’s good for the entire family.

brands.description:
WHBM exists to celebrate and support women with a collection of versatile, modern pieces, exceptional customer service and expert styling advice, dedicated to providing everyday luxury for on-the-go, multifaceted lives.

Although named for the simplicity of black and white, the modern, curated collections always reflect the latest colors, prints and styles. WHBM expert stylists can always help transform a closet, style the current trends or create a unique look—and their services are always complimentary. In boutiques and online, exceptional personal service is the hallmark of everything WHBM does and customers always come first.
